# Emigration Aid

> Expert visa and education consultancy based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Established in 2009 with 17+ years of experience, 500+ successful student placements, and 20+ destination countries.

## About

- [Homepage](https://www.emigrationaid.com/): Main landing page with services overview, destination countries, testimonials, and consultation booking.
- [Destinations](https://www.emigrationaid.com/destinations.html): Detailed information on 20+ study and immigration destination countries.
- [Full Site Content](https://www.emigrationaid.com/llms-full.txt): Complete site content in a single markdown document for comprehensive context.

## Services

- [Student Recruitment & Placement](https://www.emigrationaid.com/#services): University selection, course matching, application filing, and student visa preparation.
- [Skilled Immigration](https://www.emigrationaid.com/#services): Permanent residency pathway mapping, credential assessment, Express Entry profiling.
- [One-on-One Counseling](https://www.emigrationaid.com/#services): Personalized career goal sessions, scholarship matching, financial auditing, and visa roadmaps.
- [Pre-Departure Briefings](https://www.emigrationaid.com/#services): Flight orientation, health coverage, international banking, and safety guidelines.
- [Post-Arrival Assistance](https://www.emigrationaid.com/#services): Airport pickup coordination, housing shortlists, and part-time job mentoring.

- [Contact & Booking](https://www.emigrationaid.com/#contact): Free consultation form, office address, phone numbers, and email.
